method.request_latency: Caller writes pre-serialized request to persistent worker and reads one complete response; caller JSON encoding and decoding excluded.
method.worker_service: Instrumented interval after input read through response cleanup. Includes response cleanup after the caller can receive the reply; excludes caller input transfer/read and instrumentation report emission.
method.sampling: Request phases measured each race. Internal tick phases sampled every 32 ticks with rotating request offset. Approximate child times subtract a 22.96 ns empty-timer cost and normalize within the enclosing measured phase; not independent additive costs.
method.request_order: Alternating baseline and instrumented executable order. Main evidence is the non-overlapping level-1 run.
method.allocation_counts: Separate allocator-instrumented build. Counts allocation and reallocation calls; requested bytes are cumulative, not peak resident memory.
caveats: Different race sets for 9 and 18 runners; distances and skills differ, so this is not a controlled doubling-of-field experiment.
Five warmup requests do not prewarm every course; first encounters within the measured sequence are included.
Wall-clock measurements are affected by Windows scheduling and machine load.
Prototype validation is byte agreement against the current engine on the stated workloads; full-corpus acceptance remains necessary before production adoption.

prototypes.scope: Isolated proof-of-concept builds; five repeats of 30 races per group, five warmups, alternating engine order; no production changes. Each output compared byte-for-byte.
